title: How AI Changed Software Development Forever — Building the Agentic Future with Andre Baltieri [MVP]
description:
AI has moved from autocomplete to agents that plan and write most of the code, and developers wonder what is left for them. Microsoft MVP Andre Baltieri shares how he builds with AI coding agents, Microsoft Agent Framework and .NET, and why context, RAG and security matter more than model choice. A practical episode for developers and architects moving existing applications into the agentic era.
In this episode
00:00 – AI is changing software development02:21 – Software development since 200307:34 – AI coding assistants versus agents13:39 – Microsoft Agent Framework and .NET32:58 – Deterministic code, probabilistic AI38:27 – Context, RAG and memory51:21 – Security, least privilege and prompt injection62:15 – Cost, generative AI and rapid fire
Key takeaways
AI agents now write most of the code, but developers are still needed to understand business rules, provide good context and orchestrate the agents.Microsoft Agent Framework lets .NET teams expose existing functions to AI through MCP and connect multiple models with little code.Security comes first: give agents least privilege, expose only small purpose-built functions and add guardrails against prompt injection.
Worth quoting
“this doesn't mean that we, we don't need programmers anymore. I think there's a bit of misconception out there, because AI can generate code for us.” – Andre Baltieri (05:58)
“I close the conversation and start another conversation because it starts with a clean context that, that would be say, you can clear the context, but I prefer to start a new, a new context.” – Andre Baltieri (49:11)
